38263-wild-life-in-the-land-of-the-giant.title: Wild Life In The Land Of The Giants A Tale Of Two Brothers
38263-wild-life-in-the-land-of-the-giant.creator: Gordon Stables
38263-wild-life-in-the-land-of-the-giant.description: A book by Gordon Stables. a deal maiden aunts have to account for, as often as not! Yes, it was all owing to Aunt Serapheema, and even to this day I cannot help thinking she owes us a very ample apology.

76770-aspects-of-jewish-power-in-the-uni.title: Aspects Of Jewish Power In The United States
76770-aspects-of-jewish-power-in-the-uni.creator: Unknown
76770-aspects-of-jewish-power-in-the-uni.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. To those who have been surprised and confounded by the widespread evidence, which even the newspapers have been unable to suppress, that the bulk of the organized bootlegging which is being carried on in this country is in the hands of Jews, it would have been less of a surprise had they known the liquor history of this country.

arxiv-2110-04847.title: Nonparametric Tests of Conditional Independence for Time Series
arxiv-2110-04847.creator: Xiaojun Song, Haoyu Wei
arxiv-2110-04847.description: Abstract We propose consistent nonparametric tests of conditional independence for time series data. Our methods are motivated from the difference between joint conditional cumulative distribution function (CDF) and the product of conditional CDFs. The difference is transformed into a proper conditional moment restriction (CMR), which forms the basis for our testing procedure.

arxiv-2111-10605.title: Exploiting Multi-Scale Fusion, Spatial Attention and Patch Interaction Techniques for Text-Independent Writer Identification
arxiv-2111-10605.creator: Abhishek Srivastava, Sukalpa Chanda, Umapada Pal
arxiv-2111-10605.description: Abstract Text independent writer identification is a challenging problem that differentiates between different handwriting styles to decide the author of the handwritten text. Earlier writer identification relied on handcrafted features to reveal pieces of differences between writers. Recent work with the advent of convolutional neural network, deep learning-based methods have evolved.

arxiv-2208-07680.title: Nonlinear response theory for Markov processes IV: The asymmetric double well potential model revisited Revised version
arxiv-2208-07680.creator: Gregor Diezemann
arxiv-2208-07680.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gregor Diezemann. The dielectric response of non-interacting dipoles is discussed in the framework of the classical model of stochastic reorientations in an asymmetric double well potential (ADWP). In the nonlinear regime, this model exhibits some pecularities in the static response. We find that the saturation behavior of the symmetric double well potential model does not follow the Langevin function and only in the linear regime the standard results are recovered.

arxiv-2301-13414.title: Incentive Compatibility in the Auto-bidding World
arxiv-2301-13414.creator: Yeganeh Alimohammadi, Aranyak Mehta, Andres Perlroth
arxiv-2301-13414.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yeganeh Alimohammadi, Aranyak Mehta, Andres Perlroth. Auto-bidding has recently become a popular feature in ad auctions. This feature enables advertisers to simply provide high-level constraints and goals to an automated agent, which optimizes their auction bids on their behalf. These auto-bidding intermediaries interact in a decentralized manner in the underlying auctions, leading to new interesting practical and theoretical questions on auction design, for example, in understanding the bidding equilibrium properties between auto-bidder intermediaries for different auctions.

arxiv-2308-13662.title: REFT: Resource-Efficient Federated Training Framework for Heterogeneous and Resource-Constrained Environments Conference: ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 25–29, 2024; Barcelona, Spain
arxiv-2308-13662.creator: Humaid Ahmed Desai, Amr Hilal, Hoda Eldardiry
arxiv-2308-13662.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Humaid Ahmed Desai, Amr Hilal, Hoda Eldardiry. Federated Learning (FL) plays a critical role in distributed systems. In these systems, data privacy and confidentiality hold paramount importance, particularly within edge-based data processing systems such as Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices deployed in smart homes. FL emerges as a privacy-enforcing sub-domain of machine learning that enables model training on client devices, eliminating the necessity to share private data with a central server.

arxiv-2311-14751.title: Efficient prediction of attosecond two-colour pulses from an X-ray free-electron laser with machine learning
arxiv-2311-14751.creator: Karim K. Alaa El-Din, Oliver G. Alexander, Leszek J. Frasinski, Florian Mintert, Zhaoheng Guo, Joseph Duris, Zhen Zhang, David B. Cesar, Paris Franz, Taran Driver, Peter Walter, James P. Cryan, Agostino Marinelli, Jon P. Marangos, Rick Mukherjee
arxiv-2311-14751.description: Abstract X-ray free-electron lasers are sources of coherent, high-intensity X-rays with numerous applications in ultra-fast measurements and dynamic structural imaging. Due to the stochastic nature of the self-amplified spontaneous emission process and the difficulty in controlling injection of electrons, output pulses exhibit significant noise and limited temporal coherence.

arxiv-2402-09215.title: Modeling of groundwater flow in porous medium layered over inclined impermeable bed
arxiv-2402-09215.creator: Petr Girg, Lukáš Kotrla
arxiv-2402-09215.description: Abstract . We propose a new mathematical model of groundwater flow in porous medium layered over inclined impermeable bed. In its full generality, this is a free-surface problem. To obtain analytically tractable model, we use generalized Dupuit-Forchheimer assumption for inclined impermeable bed.

arxiv-2502-18991.title: tūQ: a design and modelling tool for cluster-state algorithms
arxiv-2502-18991.creator: Greg Bowen, Simon Devitt
arxiv-2502-18991.description: Abstract This paper is a general introduction to the tūQ toolchain ( https://github.com/QSI-BAQS/tuQ ) and a discussion of its two main workflows, ‘reduce and optimise’ and ‘draft and compile’ . The tūQ toolchain was designed to advance research in cluster-state computing and the workflows are presented as suggestions for how a researcher might use the tool.

arxiv-2508-10694.title: Effective permeability conditions for diffusive transport through impermeable membranes with gaps
arxiv-2508-10694.creator: Molly Brennan
arxiv-2508-10694.description: Abstract Membranes regulate transport in a wide variety of industrial and biological applications. The microscale geometry of the membrane can significantly affect overall transport through the membrane, but the precise nature of this multiscale coupling is not well characterised in general.

pmc-11423858.title: The roles of TAF1 in neuroscience and beyond
pmc-11423858.creator: Elisa M Crombie, Karen Cleverley, H T Marc Timmers, Elizabeth M C Fisher
pmc-11423858.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The transcriptional machinery is essential for gene expression and regulation; dysregulation of transcription can result in a range of pathologies, including neurodegeneration, cancer, developmental disorders and cardiovascular disease. A key component of RNA polymerase II-mediated transcription is the basal transcription factor IID, which is formed of the TATA box-binding protein (TBP) and 14 TBP-associated factors (TAFs), the largest of which is the TAF1 protein, encoded on the X chromosome (Xq13.1).

pmc-11478335.title: The Effect of Lacticaseibacillus paracasei LPC100 and Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LP140 on Bone Mineral Density in Postmenopausal Women: A Multicenter, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study
pmc-11478335.creator: Joanna Głogowska-Szeląg, Ilona Palka-Kisielowska, Wiesława Porawska, Joanna B. Bierła, Agnieszka K. Szczepankowska, Tamara Aleksandrzak-Piekarczyk, Bożena Cukrowska
pmc-11478335.description: Objectives: modulation of gut microbiota by probiotics has been proposed as a target for intervention to reduce bone mineral density (BMD) loss in the postmenopausal period. This study aims to evaluate the effect of Lacticaseibacillus (L.) paracasei LPC100 and Lactiplantibacillus (L.) plantarum LP140 on BMD in postmenopausal women in a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.

pmc-11512242.title: In Vitro Antitumor Effect of Oils Rich in CBD and THC Cannabis Extract in Canine Prostate Carcinoma Cell Lines
pmc-11512242.creator: Luís Gustavo Ramos de Moraes Calheiros, Giovana Pedro, Thayna Oliveira da Silva, Rogério Martins Amorim, Carlos Eduardo Fonseca Alves, Renée Laufer-Amorim, Louise van der Weyden
pmc-11512242.description: Simple SummaryProstate cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer deaths worldwide, even when found early in the disease, in both humans and dogs. Prostate cancer in dogs is common and is very similar to human prostate cancer, making them excellent models for comparative studies.

pmc-11599063.title: RNA-Seq Reveals Transcriptome Changes Following Zika Virus Infection in Fetal Brains in c-Flip Knockdown Mice
pmc-11599063.creator: Ting Xie, Qiqi Chen, Nina Li, Shengze Zhang, Lin Zhu, Shaohui Bai, Haolu Zha, Weijian Tian, Chuming Luo, Nan Wu, Xuan Zou, Shisong Fang, Yuelong Shu, Jianhui Yuan, Ying Jiang, Huanle Luo
pmc-11599063.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The FADD-like interleukin-1β converting enzyme (FLICE)-inhibitory protein (c-FLIP) plays a crucial role in various biological processes, including apoptosis and inflammation. However, the complete transcriptional profile altered by the c-FLIP is not fully understood. Furthermore, the impact of the c-FLIP deficiency on the transcriptome during a Zika virus (ZIKV) infection, which induces apoptosis and inflammation in the central nervous system (CNS), has not yet been elucidated.

pmc-12581461.title: Vaccine effectiveness against influenza A in older adults and the effect of chronic conditions: results from the I-MOVE and VEBIS multicentre European hospital case–control studies, 2015/16–2023/24
pmc-12581461.creator: Angela Mary Catherine Rose, Nathalie Nicolay, Clara Mazagatos, Iván Martínez-Baz, Odile Launay, Laurane De Mot, Antonino Bella, Mihaela Lazar, Ausenda Machado, Monika Kuliešė, Stephen Abela, Vesna Višekruna Vučina, Rianne van Gageldonk-Lafeber, Silvia Bino, Ralf Dürrwald, Iwona Paradowska-Stankiewic
pmc-12581461.description: BackgroundThe Influenza – Monitoring Vaccine Effectiveness in Europe (I-MOVE/I-MOVE+) and Vaccine Effectiveness, Burden and Impact Studies (VEBIS) hospital networks have conducted seasonal multicentre, test-negative, case–control studies in Europe to measure influenza vaccine effectiveness (IVE) since 2015/16. We measured the effect of chronic conditions on VE of influenza A subtypes among older adults (≥ 65 years) using pooled-season data (2015/16–2023/24).

pmc-12612994.title: Early stoppage of empirical antibiotic therapy in paediatric acute leukaemia with high-risk febrile neutropenia: a randomized, open-label, phase 3, non-inferiority trial
pmc-12612994.creator: Santosh Kumar Chellapuram, Santosh Kumar Kn, Manraj Singh Sra, Rupak Kumar Giri, Deepam Pushpam, Atul Batra, Sreenivas Vishnubhatla, Shuvadeep Ganguly, Sameer Bakhshi
pmc-12612994.description: SummaryBackgroundEmpirical antibiotic therapy (EAT) is commonly continued until recovery of neutrophil counts in paediatric acute leukaemia with high-risk febrile neutropenia. This study assessed whether early discontinuation of EAT was non-inferior to the continuation of EAT until absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥500/μL among children with high-risk febrile neutropenia.

pmc-12707595.title: Acute postoperative parotitis following frontal interhemispheric craniotomy: A case report
pmc-12707595.creator: E. Ianick Rodrigues Pires BS, Jacob J. Knittel, Daniel G. Gridley, Syed A. J. Zaidi, Salvatore C. Lettieri, Iman Feiz-Erfan
pmc-12707595.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Acute postoperative major salivary gland adenitis is a rare complication characterized by swelling of the salivary glands, most commonly associated with skull base neurosurgical procedures. Its occurrence following supratentorial non-skull base craniotomies is uncommon and may be overlooked.Case Description: We report a 45-year-old man who developed ipsilateral parotid gland inflammation within 24 h after undergoing a frontal interhemispheric craniotomy for resection of a craniopharyngioma. The procedure was performed in the supine position with 90° head rotation and 45° neck flexion.

pmc-13261096.title: ω‐3PUFAs Inhibit Gallbladder Cancer Through Enhancing STK31 Methylation
pmc-13261096.creator: Shuang‐Xing Li, Wei‐Yu Zhu, Hai‐Ying Peng, Bin Zhang, Zhu‐Ying Lin, Song‐Lin Yang, Yi‐Yi Zhao, Hui Gao, Shan He, Yuan Liu, Xiao‐Dan Wang, Yang‐Fan Guo, Wen‐Ju Wang, Zong‐Liu Hou, Ming‐Yao Meng, Li‐Wei Liao, Lin Li
pmc-13261096.description: Gallbladder cancer (GBC) is an aggressive malignancy with limited treatment options. ω‐3PUFAs have known anticancer activity, but their role in GBC remains unclear. The anti‐GBC effects of ω‐3PUFAs (DHA/EPA) were evaluated using in vitro assays and mouse xenograft models. Epigenetic changes were analyzed by RRBS, MSP, and MethyLight PCR. Downstream mechanisms were explored via proteomics, Co‐IP, and Western blot.

pmc-13285560.title: Galleria mellonella proteomic response to infection with Streptococcus pyogenes
pmc-13285560.creator: Corina Abt-Becker, Josefine Burzlaff, Stefan Mikkat, Bernd Kreikemeyer, Nadja Patenge

pmc-13426525.title: Anteroplacement of the Mucocutaneous Junction and Goblet Cell Expansion: Microanatomic Remodeling of the Human Eyelid Margin
pmc-13426525.creator: Xiaowei Yang, Meizhen Zeng, Xulin Zhang, Lingyi Liang, Haotian Lin
pmc-13426525.description: PurposeThe mucocutaneous junction (MCJ) plays a vital role in maintaining ocular surface health and integrity. However, the corresponding histopathological changes of the MCJ in human eyelids remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the pathological alterations of the MCJ and their relationship with meibomian gland (MG) morphology and advancing age.

pmc-13454223.title: Food Availability Cannot Explain Dispersal and Settlement Decisions of a Grassland Bird
pmc-13454223.creator: Emily J. Williams, Theo K. Michaels, W. Alice Boyle
pmc-13454223.description: Food abundance is often postulated to shape animal habitat selection and movements. Those behaviors are critical to life‐history variation and making informed management decisions. However, the importance of food in shaping animal behavior is more often assumed than empirically tested.

pmc-13711175.title: Diagnostic utility of transit time flow measurement for predicting early coronary bypass graft occlusion
pmc-13711175.creator: Rosa Kolb, Islam Salikhanov, Brian M Mawad, Luise Voehringer, Ion Vasiloi, Saskia Rabe, Brigitta Gahl, Christian Mueller, Denis Berdajs
pmc-13711175.description: ObjectiveThe study objective was to evaluate the predictive value of intraoperative graft flow and pulsatility index for early in-hospital graft occlusion.MethodsWe prospectively included 634 patients undergoing isolated coronary bypass grafting surgery between 2020 and 2025. To assess bypass flow, intraoperative transit-time flow measurements were performed.
